capabilities: copy a note to the clipboard as styled HTML
download a note as an HTML file
embed images as base64 during export
extras: The README states the plugin is a work in progress, that inline image export has edge cases, and that Obsidian mobile apps are not yet supported.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hand a note to HTML-based destinations like email clients or Word while keeping formatting and images.
summary: Markdown-to-HTML exporter that copies a note's styled HTML to the clipboard or saves it as an HTML file with embedded images.
